footer.about: Smart MealMatch connects meal planning with grocery buying for households in Kigali.

about.title: About Smart MealMatch
about.body:
Smart MealMatch is a student project from the University of Rwanda, College of Science and Technology. It helps households decide what to cook, estimate what it will cost and buy the ingredients in the way that suits them.

This website is a prototype. Sellers, prices, ratings, chefs and payments are sample data while we test the idea with real users.

how.title: How it works
how.body:
1. Tell us about your household: how many people, your weekly budget in RWF, cooking time, preferences and allergies.

2. We build a plan from local recipes that fit your answers and estimate the cost of every meal.

3. We total the ingredients and subtract what you already have.

4. You choose how to buy: a market list with price ranges, verified sellers with mobile-money payment, or a WhatsApp order the seller confirms.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Not yet. This prototype uses sample prices. Each price shows its source (seller price or market estimate) and how old it is.
faq.a2: The current planner uses rules: it filters recipes by your allergies, diet and time, then fits them to your budget. A language model will help with planning in a later version.
faq.a3: MTN MoMo and Airtel Money are planned. In this prototype payments are simulated and no money is charged.
faq.q4: Why do I need an account?
faq.a4: Your household, plans, pantry and orders are saved to your account so they are there when you return.
faq.a5: Each seller delivers their part of your order or lets you collect it. Delivery fees are sample values until sellers confirm them.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body:
In this prototype everything you enter is stored only in this browser. Nothing is sent to a server.

We never ask for or store mobile-money PINs. Passwords are stored as a one-way hash, never as text.

A full privacy policy will be published before launch.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body: This website is a prototype for testing and coursework. Prices, sellers, products and payments are simulated and are not offers to sell. Full terms will be published before launch.

delivery.title: Delivery and returns
delivery.body:
Each seller delivers within Kigali (Gasabo, Kicukiro and Nyarugenge) or offers collection. Delivery fees and times shown are sample values.

Returns and refunds policy: to be confirmed with sellers. Fresh food issues will be reported to the seller through your order page.
